## Appearance

John Meredith has pale skin and dark hair, and he occasionally appears flushed in moments of emotional distress. He sometimes forgets his outward appearance when lost in his thoughts, appearing in carpet slippers, a faded dressing gown, and with unbrushed hair.

_Sources: [v5 c14 P0](../source/v05-c14.md#nw-v05-c14-p0000), [v5 c28 P26](../source/v05-c28.md#nw-v05-c28-p0026)_

## Personality

John Meredith is a deeply spiritual, shy, and aloof man who retains the heart of a boy. He is intensely absent-minded, frequently losing himself for days in theological studies or reading, often completely oblivious to his surroundings, meals, and parish duties. Despite his abstraction, he loves his children deeply and possesses a hidden, quiet sense of humor. He holds steadfast to his romantic ideals and high personal standards, refusing to marry merely out of common sense or parish necessity.

_Sources: [v5 c13 P2](../source/v05-c13.md#nw-v05-c13-p0002), [v5 c14 P0](../source/v05-c14.md#nw-v05-c14-p0000), [v5 c14 P37](../source/v05-c14.md#nw-v05-c14-p0037), [v5 c21 P2](../source/v05-c21.md#nw-v05-c21-p0002), [v5 c21 P3](../source/v05-c21.md#nw-v05-c21-p0003), [v5 c21 P8](../source/v05-c21.md#nw-v05-c21-p0008), [v5 c33 P22](../source/v05-c33.md#nw-v05-c33-p0022)_

## History

After the sudden death of his beloved wife Cecilia in Maywater, John Meredith became the Presbyterian minister at Glen St. Mary, living in the manse with his four children and Aunt Martha. Deeply immersed in his theological studies, he frequently neglected his daily surroundings, his parish duties, and the guidance of his children. While walking through Rainbow Valley, he formed a close, unreserved friendship with young Walter Blythe, and soon after met Rosemary West by the spring. Recognizing his deep feelings for Rosemary, he eventually proposed marriage to her, but was devastated when she sent him a cool letter of refusal. Stunned by parish criticism regarding his children's upbringing and terrified when his daughter Una fainted in church, he resolved to be a more attentive father despite his heartbreak over losing Rosemary.

_Sources: [v5 c5 P128](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0128), [v5 c9 P86](../source/v05-c09.md#nw-v05-c09-p0086), [v5 c9 P87](../source/v05-c09.md#nw-v05-c09-p0087), [v5 c13 P2](../source/v05-c13.md#nw-v05-c13-p0002), [v5 c13 P5](../source/v05-c13.md#nw-v05-c13-p0005), [v5 c14 P0](../source/v05-c14.md#nw-v05-c14-p0000), [v5 c14 P36](../source/v05-c14.md#nw-v05-c14-p0036), [v5 c21 P0](../source/v05-c21.md#nw-v05-c21-p0000), [v5 c21 P28](../source/v05-c21.md#nw-v05-c21-p0028), [v5 c22 P41](../source/v05-c22.md#nw-v05-c22-p0041), [v5 c28 P26](../source/v05-c28.md#nw-v05-c28-p0026)_
